messages:
Maya: Quick design check — proposing compact roles list with collapsible per-role details instead of full matrix. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/roles-compact-proto
Alex: like the idea, saves vertical space. main concern: discoverability for inherited perms. maybe add a chevron + 'Details' label.
Sam: engineering note: collapse state needs to be accessible via keyboard (Enter/Space) and preserve focus. also prefer aria-expanded on the button.
Emi: accessibility: ensure chevron has aria-label "Toggle role details"; don't rely on color alone for read-only vs editable.
Maya: copy q: primary CTA on invite modal — should we say 'Invite members' or 'Add people'? leaning 'Invite members' for clarity.
Alex: 'Invite members' is clearer for org context. Use smaller secondary link 'Invite via link'.
Sam: backend: we return invite_sent boolean and invite_link; ok for having both paths. modal should disable Send until emails present.
Maya: SSO toggle wording — current label 'SSO Login' confused PMs. proposed: 'Require SSO for organization' with tooltip 'Enforces SSO for all org accounts.'
Emi: keep tooltip keyboard accessible and include a longer explainer on hover/focus. Also contrast on toggle text hits 3:1 — need 4.5:1 ideally for small text.
Alex: audit nav: add quick presets (Last 24h, 7d, 30d) and deep-link per event id. placeholder: 'Search by user, action, or resource (e.g., jane@...)'
Javi: Audit deep links should include event_ts param so we can anchor in logs for support tickets.
Maya: visual: when a role is collapsed, show top 3 permissions as chips, rest inside details — helps scanning.
Sam: implementation detail: chips clickable to filter audit logs for that permission.
Emi: keyboard: ensure chips are focusable and have role=button, proper aria-pressed when active.
Alex: small copy tweak: change 'Owner controls' to 'Org administrators' — tests showed users confused by 'owner'.
Maya: tiny a11y nit: focus ring removed in prod button variant — we need to re-add outline for keyboard users.
Alex: will update figma, attaching prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/roles-compact-proto?node-id=42
figma-bot: Updated file: roles-compact-proto — frame 'Invite modal v3' updated by Alex.
Maya: next steps: Alex to push updated mock, Emi to run quick a11y checklist, Sam to spike keyboard patterns. review Thursday 10am.
Sam: noted, i'll add aria attributes in the PR and include a small snippet in docs:
Sam: ```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="role-42-details">Details</button>
```
Maya: thanks all! :thumbsup:
